snippet.title: My squad kept kicking each other instead of fighting the robots 💀 – DUSTWIRE
snippet.description:
Three raiders, one mission... and way too many kicks 🦵 A trio raid in DUSTWIRE, a colorful PvPvE extraction shooter: fight drones and giant spider bots in Wirehaven, then betray your buddy at the extraction station.

🎮 Free Playtest in December, request access + wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5182080/Dustwire/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trio_kicks
Search DUSTWIRE on Steam 🔎
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/FhgFCspJG8

Early Access: March 2, 2027 #dustwire #extractionshooter #indiegame
